messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — heads up: several customers reported 5xx errors from the Hosted API starting ~12:02 UTC. I need a short, customer-friendly status update we can send to affected accounts. Which accounts are impacted and what's the mitigation?

Jon (SRE): Investigating root cause now. Preliminary: a DB failover caused spike in request latencies, which then triggered throttles in the inference router. Working on revert for the bad failover path.

Raj (SE): We pushed a hotfix to routing logic at 12:10 that should stop the throttles. Also enabling more conservative batching for impacted hosts to reduce timeouts.

deploy-bot: deployment "routing-hotfix-2026-03-20" started by @raj at 12:11 UTC — status: in_progress

Evan (AE): Two renewal-risk accounts (AcmePay, NovaResearch) pinged CSMs directly. They want ETA and whether data was exposed.

Maria (CS): Important — no evidence of data exfiltration. Please confirm for legal. Also need a 1-2 sentence blurb for customers: what happened, current status, ETA, and any user impact. Keep it non-technical.

Jon (SRE): Confirming: no private data accessed. Cause: unexpected DB failover + downstream router cascade. Mitigation: routing hotfix deployed, failover path rolled back, extra capacity in pool. Error rate dropping from 18% -> 3% in last 5m. ETA for full recovery: 20–30 mins to clear queues.

Raj (SE): Suggested customer message draft below. Feel free to shorten: 
```
We experienced a service disruption affecting model responses for some customers starting at 12:02 UTC. Our engineers identified the issue as a failover-related routing cascade and have deployed a fix. We do not believe any customer data was exposed. Response rates are improving and we expect normal service within 30 minutes. We will follow up with an incident report and any relevant remediation steps.
```

Simon (Support): Recommend offering 1:1 calls for AcmePay & NovaResearch. Assigning @Evan to coordinate. Also flagging for account health review.

Evan (AE): I'll reach out to both—requesting CSMs include the 1-paragraph draft and availability for a short call. If either asks for credits, we'll escalate.

Maria (CS): Finalizing message for outbound. Adding short bullet about next steps / RCA timeline. Sending now to list of affected customers. Can everyone react when you’ve DM'ed your accounts? :thumbsup:

Jon (SRE): Monitoring. Will post postmortem link when ready.

deploy-bot: deployment "routing-hotfix-2026-03-20" finished by @raj at 12:18 UTC — status: success

Maria (CS): Update sent to affected accounts at 12:20 UTC. AcmePay requested a call at 13:00 UTC. NovaResearch wants a short email follow-up only. Thanks all.
